head: codex/5683-v0918-unity-observatory-visual-remediation
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][demo] Remediate flagship Observatory render artifacts and presentation proof
body:
Closes #5683

Remediates the flagship Unity Observatory hero stage by removing incompatible particle and prefab artifacts, grounding the command deck in a coherent room composition, and retaining direct Full HD and QHD Unity proof. The shell remains truthfully labeled as demo, contract-only, fixture projection rather than claiming live CSM authority.

Focused proof passed: live Unity-MCP project and scene alignment, 43 prefab instances / 107 objects / 4 cameras / 7 lights, exact 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 Game View selection and captures, decoded raw-image dimension checks, the Unity Observatory contract guardrail, and git diff hygiene. Hooke completed exact-revision review with no actionable findings.
